Bruno, what time do you wake up in Brazil?
I wake up at five thirty. School starts at seven.
Five thirty? Wow. I wake up at six thirty and I am always tired.
Do you have breakfast before school?
Yes, with my mother. My brother doesn't. He only drinks water.
And after school? Do you practice every day?
Three days a week. I don't practice on the weekend. And you?
I don't practice with a team now. I play with my friends and I study English.
I wake up at five thirty in the morning.
School starts at seven o'clock.
After school I do my homework.
I don't practice on the weekend.
At night I am very tired.

Hi, I am Ashley. Let me tell you about my day. I wake up at six thirty in the morning. I have breakfast with my mother. She makes eggs every morning. My brother doesn't have breakfast. He only drinks water. School starts at eight and it finishes at three. After school I go to basketball practice. I practice three days a week. On the weekend I don't practice. I sleep, I watch television and I play video games with my friends. I am always tired on Monday.

Good morning, group two. Here is the plan for the week. We start at nine every day. On Monday and Wednesday we practice shooting. On Tuesday and Thursday we play games. On Friday we watch videos and we talk about the games. The camp doesn't open on the weekend, so you have Saturday and Sunday free. And please bring your notes from the video class. See you at nine.
